title: LACP Passive & Active
description: Configure LACP active and passive modes and learn which combinations form a channel.
scenario: Configure LACP active and passive modes and learn which combinations form a channel.

concepts.title: LACP Active vs Passive
concepts.body: active sends LACP packets to initiate a channel. passive only responds to LACP packets — it never initiates.
concepts.code:
active:  initiates negotiation
passive: responds only
on:      static, no LACP

concepts.title: Mode Combinations
concepts.body: active + active = channel forms. active + passive = channel forms. passive + passive = NEVER forms (nobody initiates).
concepts.code:
active  + active  → channel
active  + passive → channel
passive + passive → no channel!

concepts.title: LACP System Priority
concepts.body: Each switch has an LACP system priority. The lower priority switch decides which ports actively participate in the channel.

concepts.title: Verifying LACP
concepts.body: "show etherchannel summary" shows the protocol as LACP. "show lacp neighbor" lists the LACP partner details.
concepts.code:
SW1# show etherchannel summary
Group  Port-channel  Protocol  Ports
